scope: Static reward-ledger contract only. It does not add score, XP, level, item, or field-drop runtime state.

sources.evidence: Five source boss scores, boss-unit AddHeroXPSwapped flow, n01D/n01K drops, and farmer level reward thresholds.
Explicit score messages: wolf stone 100; H012 150; H00X 300; H013 450; H01B 700; H01O 1000.
Drop probability, level-reward item rawcodes, and current MVP translation boundaries.
Item class, item effect descriptions, and source acquisition context.
Current EnemyConfig.score values are data only; no score ledger is connected.
Existing economy inventory has six slots and supports I006 eggs only; it is not a generic combat-drop inventory.

ledgers.score: A run-scoped integer per player. It is not gold, lumber, XP, supply, or an item. SP-10-17 is its only writer.
ledgers.wallet: The existing owner wallet holds only gold, lumber, supplyUsed, supplyReserved, and supplyCap. Enemy deaths grant neither gold nor lumber unless a later source-backed contract explicitly adds one.
ledgers.farmerExperience: A future run-scoped farmer XP and level ledger, separate from score. No source-backed kill-XP amount or recipient radius is available, so all ordinary and regular-boss deaths grant 0 farmer XP in the SP-10 web baseline. SP-10-18 may implement the ledger and test fixtures, not invent kill XP.
ledgers.bossExperience: The extracted AddHeroXPSwapped 150 flow targets an enum of boss units H012/H00X/H013/H01B/H01N/H01O. It is boss growth, not a player-farmer reward, and remains out of scope until a boss-growth contract exists.
ledgers.fieldDrop: A world item record, separate from wallet and inventory. SP-10-20 must extend the egg-only field/inventory model; it must not represent combat items as eggs or create a parallel hidden inventory.
ledgers.levelReward: A farmer-owner entitlement keyed by run, farmer entity, and threshold. It is separate from field drops and score. SP-10-21 applies the delivery policy.

deathEligibility.rewardable: Only one accepted alive-to-dead combat event for a runtime enemy in the active run may evaluate a reward. The stable duplicate key is runId + deadEntityId + deathSequence.
deathEligibility.recipient: Use the valid attacker owner captured by the accepted death event. A player unit, player tower, or player-owned summon awards its owner; a summon must carry its parent owner at creation. Invalid/no attacker, hostile owner, or environment damage has no player recipient and creates no score, XP, item entitlement, or wallet grant.
deathEligibility.ownership: Never infer recipient from the dead enemy owner. Multi-player mode is not implemented, but all ledgers remain keyed by player owner so future owners cannot share rewards accidentally.

ordinaryTier1To18.source: No ordinary-enemy score event is present in the inspected source artifacts.
ordinaryTier1To18.webBaseline: Use the current EnemyConfig.score values 10 through 180 by tier when SP-10-17 creates the score ledger. Mark them as web baseline, not recovered W3X values.

regularBosses.basis: source score unresolved; do not award current config score as if it were source-backed

conditionalBoss.condition: only if SP-10-16 confirms the H01O branch and creates this enemy; it is not a normal milestone reward

wolfStone.scope: neutral/event content; leave implementation and death routing to SP-12

farmerKillXp.reason: The inspected AddHeroXPSwapped evidence is boss-unit growth and gives no farmer recipient, level table, or range.

farmerThresholdRewards.delivery: SP-10-19 metadata/stats; active ability work belongs to its assigned future card

xpAndLevelPolicy.thresholdRule: An accepted XP change may cross several thresholds; process ascending thresholds once each. The delivery key is runId + farmerEntityId + threshold. Farmer absence/death does not transfer entitlement to another unit.

dropPolicy.regularOrdinaryAndMilestoneBosses: No direct item drop is evidenced for ordinary tiers or H012/H00X/H013/H01B/H01N/H01O. Do not add one.

spider.webDecision: The table is source-backed but its natural-spawn/content integration remains SP-12. SP-10-20 may exercise it only as an explicit source fixture.

specialGolem.webDecision: The source condition is GetRandomInt(1,100) >= 20 for I00O, otherwise I00P. Natural event/content integration remains SP-12.

dropPolicy.delivery: A successful reward-drop roll creates one owner-locked field item at the dead entity position. The reward owner alone may pick it up. If the six-slot inventory is full, retain the field item without expiry or duplication; never delete it, convert it to wallet currency, or give it to another owner. Level-reward items use the owner entitlement queue and are delivered to the field at the farmer position when inventory space becomes available; they are not stealable.
dropPolicy.implementationBoundary: SP-10-20 adds generic field item/pickup lifecycle. SP-10-21 adds level-item delivery. Item use effects, special-chicken creation, and event natural spawns remain SP-12.

requiredBeforeSp10Completion: Set an explicit source-backed or web-baseline Archimonde score before SP-10-17 can award it.
Keep farmer kill XP at zero unless source recovery or a separately recorded web policy supplies a table and recipient rule.
Implement generic field-item and entitlement delivery without changing egg inventory semantics or bypassing the six-slot capacity.
Ensure every accepted death path evaluates its duplicate key before score, drop, or level entitlement is written.
